title: Entity types
description: The plates. Each entity type is a table whose rows a function is replicated over. Attributes are known, fixed data (a bridge's class, an edge's length) and never become BN nodes; a ref attribute is a foreign key, and foreign keys are what route a variable from one plate to another.

singleton.description: Exactly one row per case, e.g. the scenario event. Its variables are the global ones.

attributes.description: Every row also has a string id, unique across the whole case.

ref.description: Foreign key to this entity type; the value is a row id.

minimum.description: The smallest value a number attribute takes; the check refuses a row below it.

step.description: The step a number attribute's input moves by on the page; any value can still be typed.

default.description: The value a row takes when it leaves this attribute out. Only for an attribute that is not required.
